packageRules.description: Freeze the shipped template pins (action SHAs, prek hook revs, mise tool versions, deps under template/**). They are seed values only: each generated project ships its own Renovate config and owns those bumps thereafter. Managing them here too is what makes `copier update` conflict — copier's 3-way merge sees both the template render (theirs) and the downstream file (ours) having moved the same literal to different values. Disabling updates under template/** keeps theirs == base, so the downstream's Renovate value always wins the merge cleanly. This repo's OWN workflows/prek.toml/mise.toml (root paths) stay Renovate-managed, so template CI stays current; new projects start with slightly-stale-but-valid pins that their own Renovate catches up immediately.
